hook: AI gave you a 6-paragraph essay when you needed a yes or a no.
caption:
AI gave you a 6-paragraph essay when you needed a yes or a no.

This is the thing nobody talks about.

It's not that AI is dumb. It's that AI doesn't know YOU.

Some people think in bullet points. Some people need the full context before they can trust a recommendation. Some people want the answer first and the reasoning never. Some people want to be challenged. Some people want to be supported.

AI defaults to: medium-length, balanced, slightly cautious, vaguely formal.

Which is the right fit for approximately no one.

So you've been doing this workaround thing — adding little instructions at the top of every prompt. "Be concise." "Don't use bullet points." "Skip the caveats." "Talk to me like I'm smart."

Every. Single. Time.

That's not a you problem. That's a missing context problem.

BootFile builds a profile of how your brain actually works — your reasoning style, your communication preferences, your tolerance for ambiguity — and turns it into a reusable instruction set your AI carries into every conversation.

One setup. No more re-explaining yourself.

Link in bio to build yours.
